title: 第二十六章笑话
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
一行人来到落灵城最气派的客栈。

    萧京溪等人毕竟是仙灵剑宗门下，尤其领队的皆是真传弟子，落脚之处自然择了最好的所在。

    这也理所应当，方不堕宗门颜面。

    途中，萧京溪觉察季南北似有心事，出声问道:

    “是有难处么?要不要换我来......”

    萧京溪知晓季南北并不精擅剑诀，而她一身修为，强处尽在剑道。

    季南北至多只能发挥她三成基础实力。

    她也明白，季南北并非自负之辈，直言相告不会伤他颜面。

    季南北是那种若自知不敌，便会向她求助的人。

    这也没什么不好若能帮上季南北，萧京溪是乐意的。

    季南北微微摇头，压低声音道:

    “事情没那么简单。此事明显有蹊跷。”

    “原来如此。”

    萧京溪虽未听出端倪，但季南北既这般说，那定是有问题的!

    在她看来，季南北是个极厉害的人无论是待人接物，还是筹谋算计，皆是她所见中最出众的。

    所以，相信季南北便好。

    抵达客栈后，白洁早已安排妥房间。

    虽多了几名外门弟子，却也并无妨碍。客房宽敞得很，众人也只是暂作休整。

    而季南北则将白洁与已返回的汪天韵唤至一旁。

    “师姐。”

    “萧师妹。”

    二人被季南北叫到一边，皆无怨言。

    一位是季南北(顶着萧京溪身份)的忠实仰慕者，另一位则是确实倾慕萧京溪之人。

    这倒让季南北方便不少。

    是的，汪天韵的确心仪萧京溪，只是向来有所表露，却未曾挑明。

    汪天韵并非色令智昏之徒，亦非纠缠不休之辈，反倒有些“窈窕淑女，君子好逑”的风度。萧京溪既不理会，他也便从未言明心意。

    季南北将二人唤来后，简要将妖兽占道一事述说一遍，又取出舆图，将既定行程路线指予二人观看。

    “此事，二位如何看待?”

    季南北如是问道。
content_en:
The group of people arrived at the most elegant inn in Luoling City.

    After all, Xiao Jingxi and others were members of the Immortal Spirit Sword Sect, especially since the team leaders were all true disciples, so they naturally chose the best place to stay.

    This is also natural, so as not to lose the sect’s reputation.

    On the way, Xiao Jingxi noticed that Ji Nanbei seemed to have something on his mind and asked aloud:

    "Is there any difficulty? Do you want me to do it instead..."

    Xiao Jingxi knew that Ji Nanbei was not good at sword techniques, but her only strength lay in the way of swordsmanship.

    Ji Nanbei can only use 30% of her basic strength at most.

    She also understood that Ji Nanbei was not a conceited person, and telling him frankly would not hurt his face.

    Ji Nanbei is the kind of person who will ask her for help if he knows he is outmatched.

    There's nothing wrong with that. Xiao Jingxi would be happy to help Ji Nanbei.

    Ji Nanbei shook his head slightly and lowered his voice:

    "It's not that simple. There's obviously something fishy about this matter."

    "That's it."

    Although Xiao Jingxi didn't hear any clues, since Ji Nanbei said this, there must be something wrong!

    In her opinion, Ji Nanbei is a very powerful person, no matter how he treats others or makes plans, he is the most outstanding person she has ever seen.

    Therefore, I believe Ji Nanbei will be fine.

    After arriving at the inn, Bai Jie had already arranged the room.

    Although there were a few more outer disciples, it didn't hinder him. The guest room is very spacious, and everyone is just taking a break.

    Ji Nanbei called Bai Jie and Wang Tianyun aside.

    "Sister."

    "Junior sister Xiao."

    The two of them were called aside by Ji Nanbei, and neither of them complained.

    One is a loyal admirer of Ji Nanbei (who bears the identity of Xiao Jingxi), and the other is someone who really admires Xiao Jingxi.

    This made Ji Nanbei a lot more convenient.

    Yes, Wang Tianyun did like Xiao Jingxi, but she had always revealed it but never made it clear.

    Wang Tianyun is neither a lustful person nor a person who is obsessed with things. On the contrary, she has the demeanor of a "fair lady and a gentleman who likes to fight". Xiao Jingxi ignored him, and he never made his feelings clear.

    After Ji Nanbei summoned the two of them, he briefly told them about the demonic beast occupying the road, then took out a map and showed the two of them the planned route.

    "What do you two think of this matter?"

    Ji Nanbei asked.
